meta.title: Meta and orchestration
meta.when: Start of every session, multi-agent work, handing work over, writing skills or CLAUDE.md.

planning.title: Planning, specs and decisions
planning.when: Before building: unclear idea, requirements, spec, tickets, ADRs, research, conflicting documents.

build.title: Building and changing code
build.when: Implementing features, designing modules, git flow, migrations, performance, TypeScript.

review.title: Debugging and review
review.when: Something is broken or slow; reviewing a branch; writing a PR body.

testing.title: Testing
testing.when: Browser/E2E test suites. Unit and integration tests are in `tdd` (group build).

backend.title: Backend and APIs
backend.when: NestJS code, service architecture, REST/GraphQL design, OpenAPI, logging and tracing.

data.title: Databases
data.when: Postgres design/queries, Prisma, Neon, Supabase-style Postgres.

frontend.title: Frontend, UI/UX and motion
frontend.when: Designing or building screens, React/Next.js code, UI review, accessibility, i18n, animation.

security-release.title: Security, CI/CD and release
security-release.when: Auth/input/secrets, pipelines, containers, Kubernetes, launch checklist.

seo-marketing.title: SEO and marketing
seo-marketing.when: Search visibility, schema markup, site structure, copy, conversion, analytics, launch. Needs a product-marketing context doc.

integrations.title: Provider integrations (opt-in)
integrations.when: Only when the project actually uses the provider.
